about: Ambience and spot effects for the previs, generated with Higgsfield (Mirelo text-to-audio). Effects are peak-normalised to -3 dBFS; hit_s is the loudest moment, so a cue placed at an action lines its hit up with it.

clearing.prompt: Peaceful pine forest clearing in summer at midday, gentle wind through pine needles, distant songbirds, soft insects

high.prompt: High altitude wind over a vast pine forest valley, airy and open, faint distant birds

crayon.prompt: A child drawing with a wax crayon on paper lying on grass

paper.prompt: Picking up loose sheets of drawing paper from the grass

chips_bag.prompt: Crinkling a bag of potato chips while offering it

chip_crunch.prompt: A man eating a single potato chip

phone_down.prompt: Smartphone placed face down on a cloth picnic blanket

phone_buzz.prompt: Smartphone vibrating face down on a cloth picnic blanket, two buzzes

grass.prompt: Tearing a single blade of grass, then rolling it between fingers

footsteps.prompt: Slow footsteps on short grass, a man
